title: COFF-100L Roast Log Entry
description: Schema for a single roast session log entry in the home coffee roasting lab course.

entry_id.description: Unique identifier for this log entry, e.g. COFF-100L-001

lab.description: Lab number and title, e.g. '02 - First Intentional Roast'

date.description: Date of the roast session (ISO 8601 format)

bean.description: Identity of the green coffee being roasted

name.description: Bean name or lot name, e.g. 'Yirgacheffe Natural G1' or 'Guatemala Huehuetenango Washed'

origin.description: Country and region, e.g. 'Ethiopia, Yirgacheffe' or 'Guatemala, Huehuetenango'

altitude_masl.description: Altitude in meters above sea level (if known)

source.description: Where the bean was purchased, e.g. 'Sweet Maria\'s', 'Coffee Bean Corral', 'Burman Coffee Traders'

green_weight_g.description: Weight of green beans loaded into roaster in grams

roast_session.description: Equipment and ambient conditions for the roast

equipment.description: Roasting device used, e.g. 'Fresh Roast SR800', 'West Bend Popcorn Popper'

charge_temp_f.description: Temperature of the roaster when beans were added (degrees Fahrenheit)

ambient_temp_f.description: Room temperature at time of roast (degrees Fahrenheit)

humidity_notes.description: Any notable humidity or weather conditions

heat_setting.description: Heat setting used (if equipment has discrete settings), e.g. 'Level 9', 'High'

charge_time.description: Clock time when beans were loaded, e.g. '14:32'

yellowing_time.description: Elapsed time (mm:ss) when beans turned fully yellow

first_crack_onset.description: Elapsed time (mm:ss) when first crack began

first_crack_end.description: Elapsed time (mm:ss) when first crack became infrequent or stopped

second_crack_onset.description: Elapsed time (mm:ss) if second crack began; null if not reached

drop_time.description: Elapsed time (mm:ss) when roast was stopped and beans dropped/removed

total_time_seconds.description: Total roast duration from charge to drop in seconds

development_time_seconds.description: Time from first crack onset to drop in seconds

development_time_ratio.description: Development time divided by total roast time (e.g. 0.21 = 21%)

sensory_during_roast.description: What you observed with eyes and nose during the roast

color_at_yellowing.description: Bean color description when yellowing was observed, e.g. 'pale straw-yellow, slight green center'

color_at_first_crack.description: Bean color at first crack onset, e.g. 'medium tan, cinnamon edges'

color_at_drop.description: Bean color at drop, e.g. 'medium brown, slight sheen, no oil'

aroma_early.description: Aroma during drying phase, e.g. 'grassy, hay, slight sweetness emerging'

aroma_at_maillard.description: Aroma during browning phase, e.g. 'bread, caramel, toast'

aroma_at_development.description: Aroma during development phase, e.g. 'dark fruit, wine, berry jam'

first_crack_description.description: How did first crack sound and feel? e.g. 'loud, rolling, like popcorn — lasted about 45 seconds'

roast_weight_loss_g.description: Weight of roasted beans minus green weight in grams (negative number)

roast_weight_loss_pct.description: Percentage of weight lost during roast (e.g. 14.5 = 14.5%)

post_roast_evaluation.description: Cupping and tasting results after the required rest period

rest_hours_before_cupping.description: Hours between drop and cupping session

brew_method.description: Method used to evaluate, e.g. 'SCA cupping protocol', 'pour-over', 'French press'

grind_setting.description: Grind setting used, e.g. 'coarse, cupping standard'

dry_aroma.description: Aroma of ground coffee before water, e.g. 'blueberry, jasmine, brown sugar'

wet_aroma.description: Aroma when hot water first contacts grounds (break the crust)

flavor_wheel_terms.description: Specific SCA Flavor Wheel terms used, e.g. ['blueberry', 'jasmine', 'caramel', 'dark chocolate']

notes.description: Qualitative description, e.g. 'citric, like grapefruit peel, pleasant'
Qualitative description, e.g. 'brown sugar, caramel in the finish'
Qualitative description, e.g. 'juicy, medium-full, coats the palate'

quality.description: What the finish tastes like, e.g. 'clean berry, fades to caramel'

tasting_notes_free.description: Freeform tasting notes in your own words — no constraints here

overall_rating.description: Your overall score for this roast, 1-10

defect_flags.description: Any defects detected in the cup — can be empty or ['none']

comparison_roast_id.description: Entry ID of any roast being compared to this one in the same lab

variable_changed_from_previous.description: For iteration labs: what single variable was changed from the prior roast

hypothesis.description: What you predicted would happen before the roast

hypothesis_result.description: Whether the hypothesis was confirmed, refuted, or inconclusive — and why

session_notes.description: Open-ended notes about anything notable this session — equipment behavior, surprises, things to try next time

next_adjustment.description: One specific thing you will change or investigate in the next roast of this bean
